title: Find the intersections
text: In the first petal, $$4sin\left(2\theta\right)=2$$ when $$sin\left(2\theta\right)=\frac{1}{2}$$, at $$\theta=\frac{\pi}{12}$$ and $$\theta=\frac{5\pi}{12}$$. Near the ends of the petal the rose is inside the circle, and in the middle the circle is inside the rose.

title: Add up the pieces
text: For one petal the area is $$\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}**{\pi/12}16\sin**2(2\theta)\,d\theta\cdot2+\frac{1}{2}\int_{\pi/12}**{5\pi/12}4\,d\theta=\frac{4\pi}{3}-\sqrt{3}$$ and there are $$4$$ petals, so the total is $$\frac{4}{3} \left(4\pi-3\sqrt{3}\right)$$.
